support.note: AMD GPU, ROCm 7.2 or 10.1 runtime; gfx103x only with the cesarops/rdna2-libr3d kernel build
radiance's host backend (AVX2 / AVX-512); about 1 tok/s on a 2B bf16 model, a fallback

notes: radiance (codeberg.org/StillDeadcode/radiance, Apache-2.0) serves a .rad container and reads its settings only from a YAML file. The binary is radiance-lemonade (this repo, src/bin/radiance-lemonade.rs): it takes these flags, writes the file and execs radiance, so lemond stops the server itself by PID.

{model_name} is Lemonade's model id: radiance answers 404 to a request naming any other model, so the server is configured under that name. This placeholder exists only for backend definitions (lemonade#3906), not for the adapter plane.
{device} is a HIP device list (HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES); empty means every card.
--spec-tokens 0: this radiance build refuses block-FP8 drafters, which several containers carry (MiniCPM5-2B bf16). A container with an int8 drafter can drop it to use speculative decoding.
Measured 2026-11-24: MiniCPM5-2B bf16 on an RX 6700 XT (gfx1031, RDNA2 port of libr3d) 9.3 tok/s decode, 0.22 s first token; on 8 Xeon Gold 6226 cores (host backend) 0.8 tok/s.
